title: Nightly fusion test for INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) with sample-seed drift correlation and KL guard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We've observed intermittent micro-regressions after weight-only INT8 (GPTQ/AWQ) conversions that are sensitive to sample seed and tokenization boundary conditions. Scope: add a deterministic nightly fusion/regression job that runs a compact but representative golden prompt set across multiple generator seeds, model revisions (baseline FP16, GPTQ-int8, AWQ-int8), and deployment targets (heterofleet GPU variants). The job should compute both semantic divergence (KL and pairwise token probability drift) and downstream metric deltas (BLEU/ROUGE-like proxies and answer-consistency checks) and push signals to telemetry with clear pass/fail heuristics. Goals: 1) catch subtle drift introduced by quant kernels or kernel selection changes; 2) surface actionable diffs that map to failing model/config combos; 3) provide canary-level alerts with rollback suggestions for RFC and rollout automation.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly CI job 'quant-profile-nightly-fusion' runs in <6h and completes for a 12-model matrix: FP16, GPTQ-8bit, AWQ-8bit across 4 HW targets.
Per-prompt KL divergence computed between FP16 baseline and each INT8 variant with configurable threshold; alerts fire when KL > 0.12 on more than 3 golden prompts.
Sample-seed correlation report generated: if metric deltas vary >10% across seeds a flaky-warning is attached to the run.
Regression output is stored in BigQuery and a curated diff artifact is uploaded to the run in CI with links to raw logits and token alignments.
Dashboard shows historical rolling window (30d) for each model+hw combination and exposes earliest diverging commit with PR link.
Playbook entries created for triage steps and automatic fallback (pin to previous quant-profile) if high-severity regressions detected during canary rollout.
tasks: Design golden prompt set (40 prompts) with input edge cases: long prefix, multilingual, math, code, and extraction tasks
Implement deterministic seeding harness and token-alignment exporter in runtime test agent
Add metric collectors: KL, pairwise token-likelihood-delta, fuzzy-answer-consistency, and latency tail stats
Create CI matrix and runner job 'quant-profile-nightly-fusion' in Jenkins/GitHub Actions with heterofleet labels
Wire telemetry: BigQuery export, Grafana dashboard, and CI artifact storage (GCS)
Write triage playbook and rollback automation for Dedicated/Hosted routing policies
notes: 2026-03-02: Spike complete — deterministic seeding reduces noisy flips but revealed kernel-dependent token alignment shifts on long prefixes.
2026-03-05: Discussion with runtime team: AWQ decoding path uses a fused kernel that cherry-picks kv cache strides; may explain token-prob shifting.
2026-03-08: PM feedback (Priya Singh) — prioritize customer-impacting answer-consistency over raw KL scores; adjust thresholds accordingly.
2026-03-10: Decision — use combined heuristic: (KL > 0.12 AND answer-consistency delta > 0.05) OR (KL > 0.25) to reduce false positives.
2026-03-12: UX review requested for dashboard layout and alert copy; Diego (Design) suggested adding example diff snippets to alerts for quick triage.
decisions: Use FP16 as canonical baseline rather than latest release to isolate quantization-only regressions.
Prefer KL + answer-consistency hybrid heuristic to trigger high-severity alerts to reduce noise.
Store raw logits for failing runs for deterministic replay and deeper numerical root-cause analysis.
